entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Through :- Mr. Rahul Pant, Sr. Advocate with
 Mr. Dhruv Pant, Advocate.
 V/s
Anil Gupta and others ...Respondent(s)
 Through :- Mr. Amit Gupta, Aag.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Javed Iqbal Wani, Judge
 Order

Learned counsel for the petitioners invited the attention of this Court to Section 89 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and would contend that the Section provides for overriding effect of this Act over all other food related laws and that the prosecution launched against the petitioners by the respondents has been initiated under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 which in presence of Section 89 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, is not legally valid.

Mr. Amit Gupta, AAG, appearing counsel for the respondents however, would controvert the contentions of Mr. Pant, learned senior appearing counsel for the petitioners and on contrary would contend that the prosecution launched against the petitioners under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 has been initiated validly and legally in view of Section of 97 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 which seeks to repeal the enactments and orders specified in second schedule with effect from the date on which the Act came to be enacted and came into force.
